package.description: Contingent worker hire-to-retire automation generated from exported documentation.

workflows.name: Main
workflows.description: Primary contingent worker hire-to-retire orchestration entry point.

steps.notes: Seed entry workflow so local build has an explicit main workflow.

processNodes.name: Poll Approved Hiring Requisitions
processNodes.description: Poll Jira every 15 minutes on business days for requisitions approved since Dispatcher_LastRun_Timestamp.

processNodes.name: Create Candidate Submission Work Items
processNodes.description: Create queue items for newly approved requisitions and publish vendor-facing requisition details.

processNodes.name: Screen Candidate Submission
processNodes.description: Perform duplicate, Workday history, and policy checks on candidate submissions from Queue_CandidateSubmissions.

processNodes.name: Route Exceptions or Interviews
processNodes.description: Route candidates to exception handling, interview scheduling, or rejection based on automated screening.

processNodes.name: Schedule Interview 1
processNodes.description: Schedule first-round interview using Microsoft Graph calendar availability for the Sr Developer interviewer.

processNodes.name: Capture Interview 1 Result
processNodes.description: Capture interview 1 result via Action Center and Internal App, then route to interview 2 or reject.

processNodes.name: Schedule Interview 2
processNodes.description: Schedule second-round interview for the Architect interviewer.

processNodes.name: Capture Interview 2 Result
processNodes.description: Capture interview 2 outcome and route selected candidates to SOW/PR generation.

processNodes.name: Generate SOW and PR
processNodes.description: Generate SOW, route DocuSign signature, create Coupa purchase requisition, and wait for PO issuance.

processNodes.name: Join Confirmed?
processNodes.description: Determine whether the selected candidate confirms joining or drops out before onboarding.

processNodes.name: Onboard Contingent Worker
processNodes.description: POST contingent worker to Workday, set status Active, and start BGV deadline tracking.

processNodes.name: Reconcile Invoices
processNodes.description: Retrieve pending Coupa invoices, reconcile against Certinia and PO data, then auto-approve or route to manual review.

processNodes.name: Handle High Value or Dispute Review
processNodes.description: Create Action Center review for invoice exceptions, high-value checks, or vendor disputes.

processNodes.name: Initiate Offboarding
processNodes.description: Process offboarding decision, notify vendor of notice period, and raise People Ops Jira ticket.

processNodes.name: Monitor Termination and Deprovision
processNodes.description: Monitor Workday termination, confirm IT access deprovisioning, and notify manager to collect assets.

processNodes.name: Run GDPR Retention and Erasure
processNodes.description: Run daily retention purge and Action Center-triggered erasure requests for contingent worker records.

processNodes.name: Write SOX Audit Log
processNodes.description: Write immutable structured SOX audit entries for financial events to AuditLog_CW_HireToRetire storage bucket.

processNodes.name: Lifecycle Complete
processNodes.description: End state for completed contingent worker hire-to-retire processing.

queues.name: Queue_CandidateSubmissions
queues.description: Candidate submissions from vendor portal for automated screening.

queues.name: Queue_CandidateSelected
queues.description: Selected candidates awaiting SOW and PR processing.

queues.name: Queue_JoinConfirmation
queues.description: Candidates awaiting join confirmation and onboarding.

queues.name: Queue_InvoiceReconciliation
queues.description: Monthly contingent worker invoice reconciliation work items.

queues.name: Queue_OffboardingInitiated
queues.description: Offboarding work items triggered by Services Delivery.

queues.name: Queue_Exceptions
queues.description: Central exception queue for routing manual review items.

assets.name: Dispatcher_LastRun_Timestamp
assets.description: Timestamp for requisition dispatcher delta polling.

assets.name: GDPR_RetentionDays_RejectedCandidate
assets.description: Retention window for rejected candidate records.

assets.name: SOX_HighValueInvoiceThreshold
assets.description: Threshold above which invoice approval requires review.

assets.name: BGV_DefaultDeadlineDays
assets.description: Standard BGV evidence deadline in days.

storageBuckets.name: SOW_Documents
storageBuckets.description: Generated SOWs and signed contract documents.

triggers.name: CW_Hiring_Dispatcher_Every15Min
triggers.description: Poll Jira for approved requisitions every 15 minutes on business days.

triggers.name: CW_Invoice_Polling_Every60Min
triggers.description: Poll Coupa hourly for new contingent worker invoices.

triggers.name: CW_Retention_Daily_0600
triggers.description: Run GDPR retention and erasure processing daily.

agents.description: CWLifecycleAutomationAgent for contingent worker lifecycle orchestration.
guardrails: Do not auto-terminate without explicit offboarding trigger
